_doc: The Lofted City (Systems/Lofted.cs). Five Skywright relics lie at far sites (ring minRing and out, preferring the listed world themes); a company clearing the site brings the relic home, worth relicLore. The discovery `reveal` rumours where they lie, `confirm` makes it certain, and `unlock` opens the three sizes (buildings.json lofted_spire, lofted_isle, lofted_city: grand works with "lofted": true). Spark tokens relic:<id> and relics:<n>. Once `reveal` is known the strongest hostile menace races the town: it takes a free relic firstAfter days later, then every claimEvery days; with raiseAt it raises a dark keel after raiseDays (power x 1 + power). Breaking it returns its relics. A finished city sails to a known region (Simulation.SailLofted) at speed days of flight per day of road, sailGold a day, and companies set out from under it when that's nearer.

relics.name: the Drowned Keelstone
relics.text: A keelstone the size of a hay cart. Out of the water it still lifts a hand's breadth off the ground.

relics.name: the Storm Vane
relics.text: A Skywright weathervane of blue bronze: the wind turns to where it points.

relics.name: the Anchor of Kings
relics.text: Giant-forged links that once held a city to the earth. Forty men to lift one.

relics.name: the Skywright Charter
relics.text: The Skywrights' own book of lofting, sealed in a dead king's observatory.

relics.name: the Cloud Glass
relics.text: The steering-lens of a fallen sky city. Clouds part where it looks.

found: {who} is cleared, and the company carries {relic} home to the library. The wizards will not leave it alone.
Under {who} the company finds {relic}, Skywright work from before the Long Night, and brings it home.
returned: In the ruins of {who}'s seat the town's companies find {relic} and carry it home.
{relic} comes home from the hoard of {who}, broken now.
rival: Word of the Skywright relics reaches {who}. It wants a city in the sky as much as {town} does.
{who} has heard where the Skywrights' relics lie, and sends its servants to dig.
claimed: {who}'s servants take {relic} from {site} before the town's companies reach it. Break {who} to win it back.
{relic} is gone from {site}: {who} has it now.
keel: {who} has three Skywright relics and lays a dark keel of its own. Break it before the keel rises.
Spies say {who} is building a keel of black stone. If it rises, it will be far stronger.
raised: {who}'s dark keel rises over its seat, and its hosts muster under a floating fortress.
A dark keel lifts off the ground at {who}'s seat. Every raid it sends now comes stronger.
risen: {who} lifts free of its cradle and rises over {town}, keelstones humming. Every soul in the town turns out to watch it climb.
The anchor chains pay out, the keelstones wake, and {who} rises over {town}. Nothing like it has flown since the Long Night.
